title: Valid Parentheses
description:
Given a string `s` containing only `()`, `{}`, and `[]`, determine if the input string is valid.

An input string is valid if:
- Open brackets are closed by the same type of brackets
- Open brackets are closed in the correct order
- Every close bracket has a corresponding open bracket of the same type
hint: Use a stack. Push opening brackets, pop and compare when you see a closing bracket.
outputExplanation: For "()[]{}": push (, pop matches. push [, pop matches. push {, pop matches. Stack empty → True.
